annotations.title: Discover reusable AI assets before inventing a one-off tool

description: Planning-time capability discovery for agents. Call this during autonomous planning when the task may need a reusable skill, MCP config, prompt, script, workflow, or other AI asset. Returns structured candidates, fit signals, and next MCP calls. [[tokrepo.discover-before-build]]

constraints.description: Optional constraints such as kind, policy, risk, language, prefer_verified, or must_not_modify_files.

environment.description: Optional local environment signals, such as project_type, frameworks, language, can_run_shell, can_write_files, or browser_available.

target.description: Optional agent/runtime target. Use "any" or "all" for generic cross-agent discovery.

task.description: The user goal, subtask, or capability gap the agent is planning for.

name: tokrepo_discover
